_doc: Wayfarer Ossek, Cartographer of the Fallen Roads. Scouts the Verge and the way to the Seventh Gate. Pool 'ossek' (shop id: cartographer).

lines.text: Mind the map! The ink is still wet. Wet with what, you do not want to know.
Wayfarer Ossek. I walk the Fallen Roads, the paths the angels used to come down by. Before they stopped coming down for anything but killing.
Pick a road, Sinbound. I will tell you which ones bleed.
Every map of the Verge has a hole in the middle. Shaped like a tower.
The Seventh Gate. Archons stand on its steps. Nobody has drawn what lies past it.
Nobody has tried?
Plenty have tried. Nobody has come back with a pen.
Where did they get you? No, do not tell me. Show me. Here, on the map.
Ah. Everyone dies there the first few times. I have marked it with a little skull. It is getting crowded.
I went further than ever last week. Past the clouds of the Verge, up to the outer gates.
Do you know what was guarding them? Statues. Penitent ones. Facing outward, praying at nobody.
Heaven has locked itself in, Sinbound. The question a mapmaker asks is: locked in with what?
Bells on the roads now. Inquisitors. They hang their own.
I passed a seraph strung up by its wings, with a sign around its neck. One word. DOUBTED.
Ravager! You broke the gates of the Silver City once. Which ones, exactly? I need it for the map.
All of them.
...That is not helpful, cartographically.
Warden. Your pit is the only place I have never mapped.
Nobody maps the deepest pit. It maps you.
Ah. Well. I will leave that page blank, then.
So the chair is empty. The road to it is not.
The Seventh Gate stands in between, and every Archon left in Heaven is standing on it.
I will start drawing that map now, shall I? Try to survive long enough to walk it.
The Heavens have many doors. I know which ones bleed.
North is wherever the angels are coming from. That is all the compass you need.
A road is just a scar the world agreed to keep.
Another little skull on the map. Do not worry, I use small ones.
You have been further up the Verge than most. Tell me what you saw, some time.
I found a scout's map in the ash. One of theirs. An angel's.
It shows the road past the Seventh Gate. It goes up and up, and at the very top somebody has drawn a chair, and then scribbled over it until the page tore.
Even their own maps are afraid of it. I will finish it for them.
Seraph. You flew the High Roads once. Draw them for me? I will trade you a valley.
Hexbinder. Every name you hold is a place on someone's map. Tell me a few.
Warden. If I map your pit, will it let me back out?
Ravager. Here is a map with every gate on it. Circle the ones you have not broken.
Reaper. The fields of the Verge are on page nine. Whichever ones you like.
Hive. Your flies get everywhere. One of them is on my map right now. It is standing on Heaven.
Gatekeeper. You know Heaven's doors better than I ever will. Which ones squeak?
